schema: SeaSick harpoon rope look v1 (phase 0, docs/PLAN-harpoon.md). For a Unity LineRenderer with sag; colours are sRGB hex tints that MULTIPLY the rope tile.

material.name: SS_Harpoon_Rope
material.texture: Assets/_Project/Art/WallL1/Textures/rope-tile-512.png (same tile as the packed V3_rope-tile-512.png in harpoon-v1.blend; already used by SS_WallL1_Rope / SS_StorageL1_Hemp)
material.shader: URP Lit (or the project's rope/hemp shader), base map = rope tile, base colour = tint below, emission on (black unless strained)

readability.note: 0.075 m at ~40 m from the phone-high camera is ~4-5 px on a 1080x2340 portrait screen. Keep at least minScreenWidthPx by widening with camera distance.

slack.note: dull hemp, visible belly; the part below the sea surface is clamped to the surface (rope lies on the water)

strained.note: warm glow tint: emission pulses between 0.4 and 1.2 at 3 Hz with a small width jitter (fray/creak); dead straight

blend: Lerp tint/width/sag by tension: slack (t<=0.3) -> taut (t=0.7) -> strained (t>=0.9). No step changes (the plan's ease rule).

drumCoil.note: fat static coils that spin with Winch_Drum (local X); one coil diameter 0.09 m reads as rope at phone size. Spin while reeling, opposite while paying out.
